evidence: Carries the RPC/REST/ZMQ label and adds `setprunelock` and `listprunelocks` methods in src/rpc/blockchain.cpp.
rationale: Adds RPC endpoints explicitly requested by external consumers to prevent block pruning during rescan and offline periods. As noted in the discussion, manual prune locks are 'needed to support external indexers on a pruned node' and enable external wallets to build reliably on pruned nodes without workarounds.
